This is a Fully Remote Job
About Our Client:
The organization operates in the scientific research and technology sector, providing a comprehensive digital science platform that integrates best-of-breed software applications used by over 2 million scientists globally. It addresses the challenge of enhancing scientific innovation through dynamic, multi-dimensional data and decision-making tools, supporting researchers with integrated laboratory management solutions across more than 180 countries.
About the Opportunity:
The BACKEND SOFTWARE ENGINEER (NODE.JS) role within the LabArchives team focuses on developing and maintaining backend systems that support electronic laboratory notebook, inventory, and scheduler products used worldwide. This position is pivotal in collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver robust backend services, driving the growth and global reach of these research tools.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with product, operations, and support teams to design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs.
Plan, build, test, and release new backend features primarily using Node.js.
Maintain and contribute to an existing Ruby on Rails codebase.
Develop and maintain comprehensive unit tests and contribute to automation testing frameworks.
Participate in code reviews, security audits, and performance evaluations.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent with 9+ years of experience.
Strong experience in server-side development with Node.js.
Proficient in synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns.
Experience with Ruby, preferably Ruby on Rails.
Knowledge of database design, query optimization, and data modeling.
Solid understanding of object-oriented and functional programming.
Familiarity with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and RESTful API design.
Pay Range and Compensation Package:
Base pay range $103,000—$140,000 USD.
Compensation includes base salary, benefits, and possible variable pay based on role.
Benefits & Perks:
Medical insurance
Dental insurance
Vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan with 4% company match and immediate vesting
Health spending accounts
Wellness benefits including mental health apps and fitness perks
Company-paid life and disability insurance
Flexible time off plan (for US exempt employees)
Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.
Note:
TalentHop is a recruitment partner of this role. Please note that all employment decisions, including candidate assessment, interviews, hiring, compensation, and employment terms, are made exclusively by the hiring employer.

IMMEDIATE HIRE: Full Stack Developer with QA Experience (Contract)
Coreframe Labs is hiring a contractor for one of our clients based in the UK. We’re looking for someone who can start right away.
The role
Our client has several small projects coming up and needs one person who can split their week between development and manual QA testing . If you’re a developer who understands testing and is happy to do it as a real part of the job, we’d like to hear from you.
Top priority: excellent communication skills
You’ll work directly with a UK team, so clear and confident written and spoken English is essential. You should be comfortable raising issues, giving updates and asking questions without being prompted.
Engagement
Contract: 2 months initially, with a strong chance of extension
Start: Immediate
Remote, with UK working hours
What you’ll do
Build and maintain features across the frontend and backend
Plan and carry out manual testing: write test cases, run regression checks, and log clear, reproducible bug reports
Test your own work and your teammates’ work before it ships
Work closely with the client’s team on priorities, releases and fixes
Tech stack
React
Node.js
PostgreSQL
Azure
What we’re looking for
Strong communication skills in English (top priority)
Practical development experience with React and Node.js
Experience with manual testing, or a developer with a solid grasp of QA and genuine willingness to own it
Experience with PostgreSQL and Azure
Attention to detail and a strong focus on quality
Comfortable working independently and switching between development and QA work
Nice to have
Experience working with UK or international clients
Familiarity with Jira or similar tools

Job Purpose:
As a Full Stack Developer will design, develop, maintain, and support secure, scalable, and high-performance applications across our fintech and digital platforms, including Digital Wallet, Payment Gateway, Loan Origination System, ECR, and Procurement solutions.
The role requires strong backend engineering expertise in ASP.NET Core, microservices, event-driven architecture, Kafka, Entity Framework Core, and PostgreSQL, alongside the ability to build and maintain responsive user interfaces using React.js. You will contribute across the software development lifecycle, producing reliable, testable code and collaborating with product, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams to deliver production-ready features.
Key Accountabilities:
Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using ASP.NET Core and C#.
Design and implement microservices and service-to-service integrations, applying appropriate patterns for reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Build and maintain event-driven workflows and asynchronous processing using Apache Kafka, including topics, producers, consumers, retries, and error handling.
Develop data access layers using Entity Framework Core, including efficient LINQ queries, transactions, migrations, and performance tuning.
Design, optimize, and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, queries, and database transactions.
Build and maintain frontend features using React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, reusable components, hooks, and appropriate state management.
Integrate React applications with backend REST APIs and implement secure authentication and authorization flows.
Write unit tests for backend business logic and services using a suitable .NET testing framework such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest, with mocking where appropriate.
Apply clean code, SOLID principles, dependency injection, separation of concerns, and established design patterns.
Implement input validation, secure error handling, logging, and application-level security best practices.
Troubleshoot defects, investigate production issues, and improve application performance, reliability, and observability.
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, and implementation planning.
Collaborate with product owners, QA, DevOps, and other developers to clarify requirements and deliver tested increments.
Support CI/CD pipelines, code quality checks, automated testing, and containerized deployments in collaboration with DevOps.
Maintain technical documentation for APIs, services, integrations, database changes, and operational procedures.
Minimum Qualification:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
Experience:
3–7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience in C# and ASP.NET Core.
Strong understanding of REST API design, backend architecture, and microservices-based applications.
Practical experience with Apache Kafka or a comparable event-streaming platform; Kafka experience is strongly preferred.
Strong experience with Entity Framework Core, LINQ, relational database design, and PostgreSQL.
Experience writing meaningful unit tests using xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest, including mocking dependencies and testing business logic.
Hands-on experience with React.js, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, functional components, hooks, and API integration.
Understanding of asynchronous programming, dependency injection, SOLID principles, and common software design patterns.
Experience with Git, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.
Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines; cloud deployment experience is an advantage.
Understanding of application security, authentication and authorization, and secure API development.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, with strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated environments is preferred.
Employment Type:
Full-time, On-site
Job Location:
Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan

We’re looking for a sharp, execution-focused Backend Developer to join our team on a full-time remote basis. If you love building robust backend systems and deep-diving into telephony workflows, this is for you.
What You’ll Do & What You Bring:
Backend & Architecture: Design and develop scalable backend microservices using Java (Play, Spring Boot) and Go , applying strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.
VoIP & Telephony: Architect and integrate VoIP solutions, handling SIP signaling , media streams, and call control workflows using tools like FreeSWITCH, ESL, and SIP.js.
Systems & Automation: Manage and troubleshoot Linux environments , utilizing Bash scripting to streamline operations and automate support tasks.
Core Stack & Mindset: Bring solid experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), version control (Git), and a pragmatic, no-bullshit approach to solving complex engineering problems.
The Logistics:
Location: Work from Home (Islamabad preferred)
Hours: UK Time (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM)
Start: ASAP

Python Django Developer
About Silicon Nexus
SiliconNexus is a rapidly expanding technology company delivering end-to-end solutions in Embedded Systems, Blockchain, AI/ML, and Web & Mobile Application Development . Our culture thrives on innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence . Join our team to build cutting-edge products that make a lasting impact.
Role Overview
We are looking for a talented Python Django Developer to join our backend engineering team. You will design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable web applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, high-performance solutions. This role is ideal for developers who are passionate about writing clean code, solving complex problems, and contributing to innovative projects.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Django/Django REST Framework (DRF) .
Architect and optimize RESTful APIs for frontend and third-party integrations.
Collaborate with frontend engineers to deliver seamless, user-friendly applications.
Write clean, reusable, testable code aligned with best practices and design patterns.
Ensure application performance, scalability, and security across the stack.
Implement and maintain security best practices, mitigating OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities .
Conduct peer code reviews , share feedback, and mentor junior developers.
Troubleshoot, debug, and enhance existing systems with minimal downtime.
Participate in the full SDLC : coding, testing, deployment, and automation.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field (or equivalent experience).
2–3 years of hands-on experience developing production-grade applications with Python & Django/DRF .
Strong knowledge of Django fundamentals : ORM, Views, Templates, Forms, Authentication.
Proficiency in working with relational databases (preferably PostgreSQL , MySQL, etc.) including complex queries & optimizations.
Experience in designing and consuming RESTful APIs .
Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+) for smooth integration with frontend.
Proficient in Git and version control best practices.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills .
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
Preferred Skills (Nice-to-Have)
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes , and container orchestration.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks (pytest, Selenium).
Experience with asynchronous task queues ( Celery + Redis/RabbitMQ ).
Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
What We Offer
Competitive salary with Fuel & Medical benefits .
Flexible working hours with emphasis on work-life balance .
A clear career growth pathway with professional development opportunities.
A collaborative, inclusive, and innovative culture.
Exposure to diverse projects with modern tech stacks .
How to Apply
If you’re passionate about building innovative backend solutions, we’d love to hear from you!
📩 Send your updated resume and GitHub/portfolio link to careers@silicon-nexus.com with the subject line:
“Application for Python Django Developer”

About The Company
GN is a global leader in intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions, committed to bringing people closer through innovative technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. Founded in 1869, GN has a rich heritage spanning over 150 years and employs approximately 7,000 people worldwide. Our products and services are sold in around 100 countries, spanning medical-grade hearing technology, professional collaboration tools, and gaming peripherals. The company’s portfolio includes renowned brands such as ReSound, Beltone, Interton, Jabra, BlueParrott, FalCom, and SteelSeries. GN is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen (GN.CO) and is dedicated to fostering a sense of community, openness, and understanding by combining expertise in human ear anatomy, audio, video, speech, wireless technologies, software, and miniaturization to deliver life-enhancing solutions.
About The Role
We are seeking a skilled Frontend Engineer to join our Growth Engineering team, working remotely within the United States. In this full-time role, you will be instrumental in creating seamless, customer-facing web experiences for Jabra Enhance, a product designed to support users on their hearing journey. Reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager, Growth, you will own critical web-based customer journeys from initial technical design through to delivery. You will collaborate closely with design and engineering teams to translate UI/UX concepts into accessible, high-performing, and intuitive digital products. Your expertise will help us build scalable, reusable components and improve application performance, reliability, and efficiency. This role requires active participation in Agile ceremonies and collaboration during East Coast business hours. You will contribute to our mission of Bringing People Closer by delivering exceptional web experiences that empower users and enhance their interaction with Jabra Enhance solutions.
Qualifications
Proven experience developing modern web applications using React.js and contemporary JavaScript libraries and tooling.
Strong understanding of HTML rendering, CSS, JavaScript, single-page applications, and client-side/server-side rendering.
Experience with server-side technologies such as Node.js is a plus.
Demonstrated attention to design, usability, and customer experience.
Background as a Frontend or Full Stack Engineer with a collaborative approach to delivering results.
Experience with Shopify technologies including Liquid, Storefront/Admin APIs, theme or app development is preferred but not required.
Excellent problem-solving skills and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to work effectively within Agile teams and participate in code reviews and architecture discussions.
Responsibilities
Develop and enhance customer-facing features and end-to-end web journeys using React.js, JavaScript, CSS, Relay, and GraphQL.
Plan, architect, build, and maintain core external-facing web applications that are scalable and maintainable.
Collaborate with design teams to translate UI/UX concepts into accessible, user-friendly, and technically feasible web experiences.
Create reusable components, code, and libraries to support efficient product development cycles.
Improve application performance and reliability through debugging, profiling, and optimization techniques.
Participate in code refactoring and architecture reviews to ensure high-quality, maintainable solutions.
Engage actively in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with cross-functional teams during East Coast business hours.
Contribute to a culture of open communication, practical problem-solving, and continuous improvement within the Growth Engineering organization.
Benefits
Competitive annual compensation ranging from $135,000 to $150,000, with eligibility for a discretionary bonus.
Remote work flexibility within the United States.
Opportunity to work with a global leader in hearing and audio technology.
Collaborative and inclusive team environment focused on innovation and quality outcomes.
Access to ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities.
Comprehensive support for employees including reasonable accommodations for disabilities.
Equal Opportunity
GN is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We encourage applications from women, minorities, veterans, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and persons with disabilities. GN is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in the job application process. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and join us in our mission to bring people closer through innovative technology.

Revive Business Solutions is seeking an early-career .NET Developer to support its Dealer Management Systems Integration team. This opportunity is suited to someone with approximately one to three years of professional, internship, co-op, academic, or project-based experience who is ready to build practical software development skills while contributing to business-critical applications and integrations. You will work alongside experienced developers, product owners, quality assurance professionals, and team leads in a collaborative Agile environment.
About The Company
Revive Business Solutions supports technology initiatives that help businesses connect systems, applications, and data. The Dealer Management Systems Integration team focuses on developing and supporting software solutions that enable effective communication between platforms. Team members contribute across the software development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and building features to testing, deployment support, and ongoing maintenance. This role offers an opportunity to learn from senior colleagues while helping improve and modernize applications and integrations.
About The Role
As a .NET Developer, you will assist with application enhancements, API development, system integration, testing, troubleshooting, and modernization efforts. You will work on assigned tasks with guidance from experienced team members and follow established development, documentation, and deployment practices. The role provides exposure to backend and front-end technologies, relational databases, source control, and Agile delivery. We are looking for a curious, accountable developer who communicates effectively, approaches challenges thoughtfully, and is motivated to continue developing technical expertise.
Qualifications
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required. Candidates should have approximately one year or more of experience with C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, or related object-oriented programming concepts, gained through employment, an internship, co-op, coursework, or software projects. Practical exposure to creating, consuming, testing, or supporting web APIs is expected.
Familiarity with front-end technologies such as ReactJS, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS is helpful, as is basic knowledge of XML, JSON, jQuery, and SQL. Candidates should understand fundamental object-oriented programming principles and have some awareness of REST APIs, service integration, request and response handling, data mapping, authentication concepts, and API troubleshooting. Exposure to unit or API testing, debugging, Git, branching, pull requests, and code reviews is beneficial. Familiarity with Agile tools such as Azure DevOps or JIRA is an asset. Interest in cloud platforms, Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and SOAP services is welcome. Academic, personal, internship, or open-source projects are also relevant.
Responsibilities
Contribute to enhancements, defect fixes, maintenance, and small feature development for existing web applications. Assist with building and supporting .NET APIs and integrations between internal and external systems, including work on endpoints, data mapping, error handling, logging, and connectivity troubleshooting. Write and maintain code that follows team standards and supports security, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Support testing and validation, investigate issues, and help refactor code using clean-code practices, reusable components, and design principles such as SOLID. Collaborate with developers, product owners, business partners, and quality assurance colleagues to clarify requirements and coordinate delivery. Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Follow source-control workflows, documentation practices, and deployment processes, while building knowledge of modern cloud and delivery technologies.
Benefits
This position offers the opportunity to grow through hands-on experience, collaboration with senior developers, and exposure to a range of application development and integration technologies. You will contribute to meaningful team initiatives, strengthen your understanding of the software development lifecycle, and develop your skills in an Agile environment. Specific compensation, benefits, and employment details will be provided during the hiring process.
Equal Opportunity
Revive Business Solutions is committed to providing an inclusive and respectful workplace. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, and business needs. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law.

Job Description
As an S&C Electric team member, you’ll work on projects that have real-world impact. You’ll help transform the grid for resilient and reliable power worldwide. S&C has more than a 100-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee-owned since 2012. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively. Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner.
Hours
8:00 am – 5:00 pm (Mon-Fri) Remote
Compensation
At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices. The estimated annual base salary range for this position is $72,570 - $96,152.00. Individual pay within this salary range is determined by several compensable factors, including performance, knowledge, job-related skills and experience, and relevant education or training. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual incentive plan (AIP), subject to eligibility criteria.
Join Our Team as a Software Engineer I!
The Software Engineer I is responsible for developing, testing, and debugging software under the guidance of more experienced engineers. They focus on implementing software requirements, understanding core tools, and contributing to the microgrid control software suite and supporting projects, as needed. The role will also work closely with the cybersecurity, power systems control, and electrical studies teams while supporting specific projects. The Software Engineer I continuously learns and develops foundational problem-solving skills and gains exposure to systems and industry-standard practices.
Key Responsibilities
Program Development: Assists in writing and debugging software in accordance with defined specifications, following directions from senior engineers. Supports implementation of basic features, simple problem-solving tasks, and unit test development.
Technology Advancement: Explores new technologies and articles to build a broad foundation understanding of the software engineering environment and industry trends.
Research & Documentation: Reviews existing documentation to understand requirements, architecture, and workflows. Contributes to basic documentation updates, notes, and development records to support project traceability.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works with senior engineers and project teams to clarify requirements and ensure alignment with project goals. Communicated progress effectively and asks questions to support task completion and learning.
Continuous Learning: Actively learning to understand tools, development environments, products, version control practices, and organization-specific processes. Builds awareness of broader engineering concepts without requiring deep specialization.
Compliance: Understand and comply with all applicable Company policies and rules
Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
Attend in-person or virtual meetings as requested or required.
Communicate effectively and respectfully with others.
Other responsibilities as assigned.
Required
What you’ll need to succeed:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other related field.
0-2 Years of experience in software engineering, development, embedded firmware, or computer science.
Preliminary skills in effective problem-solving and able to communicate internally.
Good interpersonal skills to establish meaningful relationships built on mutual trust and respect and foster collaborative working relationships amongst a diverse audience.
Great communication skills (written, verbal, listening, and presentation), able to partner with and communicate with customers, both technical and non-technical.
Commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the quality function.
Good organizational planning, coordinating internal and external resources, and juggling key demands.
Sound business sense and analytical skills with the ability to use and analyze data to drive informed actions, solve complex problems, and drive learning.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines, including the flexibility to work extended hours when necessary.
Great computer skills and ability to use Microsoft Office applications, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
Experience with Linux-based distributions and Java programming.
S&C Electric is committed to equal-opportunity employment. All employees and applicants will be considered without regard to age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation to complete the application, please email us at TAsupport@sandc.com.
No fixed deadline
About Us
In 1909, S&C Electric Company transformed the delivery of safe, reliable electricity with the invention of the Liquid Power Fuse. Today, as the world faces extreme weather events and the demand for electricity grows, S&C continues to innovate and advance the electrical grid, ensuring reliable and resilient power for homes, communities, and critical infrastructure around the world.
With a diverse, global workforce and core values around integrity, safety, and quality, S&C is a trusted industry leader and top workplace that offers meaningful careers to more than 3,500 team members. As a people-first organization, S&C is committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative workplace where team members advance their careers through robust talent-development programs and involved leadership.
S&C’s deeply rooted belief diversity fosters greater creativity, innovation, and success guides the company to advance and sustain a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace culture.
S&C provides a comprehensive and competitive benefit package that includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):
Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical & Prescription, Dental, Vision, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, , Health Savings Account (HSA), Group Life Insurance, optional Supplemental Life and AD&D Insurance, Wellbeing Resources including Employee Assistance Program and Family Forming Benefits (i.e., Adoption and Fertility support)
Leave Benefits: Vacation Time, Sick Time, Paid Holidays and Company Shutdown days, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves, Paid Parental Time and Military Leave
Retirement Benefits: 401(k) Retirement Savings and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (KSOP) offering traditional and Roth 401(k) options and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) component; KSOP participants can receive annual ESOP company contributions of over 11% of eligible earnings (3% Core, up to 3.5% Match, Variable Periodic).

🌎 About Us
TeamSnap is made up of innovators, technologists, builders, and problem-solvers shaping the future of youth sports. We’ve been setting the standard in youth sports technology since we were founded in 2009.
We hire for big ideas and tiny egos — which is part of how we landed on Outside Magazine's Best Places to Work , Built In's 100 Best Remote-First Places to Work and, for several years running, Sports Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in Sports .
TeamSnap is seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Backend, to join our fully distributed engineering team and help us continue scaling systems that serve millions of daily users and tens of thousands of amateur sports organizations. Our primary backend stack includes Node and TypeScript, alongside Elixir, SQL, cloud-based services, event-driven systems, queues, background jobs, caching layers, and observability tooling.
We are looking for a hands-on Staff Backend Engineer with deep, meaningful production Node experience who can build and improve APIs and services, reason through production issues across the system, lead technical design in ambiguous areas, mentor engineers, and raise the quality bar across the team. This person should bring strong systems thinking that connects application architecture with infrastructure, platform, data, security, and other adjacent domains, bringing those teams into architecture and solutioning conversations early without being expected to own those functions directly.
As an engineering team, we architect and build scalable systems using service-oriented and event-driven architecture. This role will help shape the technical foundation behind TeamSnap’s product experience, with a focus on backend systems, APIs, services, data performance, reliability, observability, and production quality.
What You'll Do:
Architect, build, and evolve backend APIs, services, event-driven workflows, queues, background jobs, data models, caching strategies, and integrations that support millions of users and thousands of sports organizations.
Own complex backend product and technical work from discovery through design, implementation, rollout, production support, and long term maintainability.
Lead ambiguous technical initiatives by breaking down problems, identifying risks, making practical tradeoffs, and helping teams move from uncertainty to clear execution.
Provide technical leadership across our Node ecosystem by advancing shared patterns, standards, tooling, and practices, and helping engineers make better Node-specific architectural and operational decisions.
Connect application architecture with platform, infrastructure, data, security, observability, and other adjacent domains, identifying concerns early and bringing the right teams into architecture, solutioning, and scaling decisions.
Improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operability of production systems through thoughtful architecture, strong testing practices, database optimization, caching, monitoring, alerting, and incident follow-up.
Debug complex production issues by reasoning across application code, databases, caches, queues, jobs, observability data, and the broader request lifecycle.
Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform, Data, Support, and other teams to turn roadmap needs into durable backend systems and practical delivery plans.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to give and receive constructive feedback, mentor engineers, influence cross-team alignment and articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
What Will Set You Up for Success:
Staff level backend engineering depth, with deep, meaningful production Node experience at scale and a strong track record of architecting, building, operating, and improving complex backend systems.
Deep Node and TypeScript experience, including strong understanding of runtime behavior, concurrency, failure modes, performance characteristics, production debugging, and the architectural tradeoffs involved in operating Node systems at scale.
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect application architecture and runtime decisions with platform, infrastructure, data, security, observability, and other adjacent domains, bringing those perspectives and teams into the process early as systems are architected, built, and scaled.
Strong SQL and relational database judgment, including indexing, query optimization, migrations, profiling, data modeling, transactions, read and write patterns, and performance tuning.
Practical understanding of service-oriented architecture, event-driven architecture, queues, background jobs, webhooks, Redis or similar caching tools, and systems that need to scale under real production load.
Working knowledge of production infrastructure and platform concerns, enough to reason through deployments, containers, CI/CD pipelines, cloud services, networking basics, observability, and operational debugging.
Strong production ownership mindset, with the ability to use logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, incident reviews, and system behavior to improve reliability over time.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, facilitate technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and connect backend technical choices to customer impact, business needs, and long term maintainability.
Bonus:
Previous work in or close partnership with infrastructure, platform, SRE, DevOps, or data teams.
Elasticsearch experience, particularly operating, scaling, troubleshooting, or designing search and indexing workloads in production.
Familiarity with BigQuery, analytics pipelines, reporting workflows, or high-volume data processing.
Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve debugging, testing, documentation, refactoring, prototyping, or developer experience without compromising quality or understanding.
Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.
Compensation
We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $200,000 inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.
🖥 Location
TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you'll need to be comfortable working with people in other time zones.
We're always expanding, but we can't currently hire in Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, or Utah. We can only hire permanent US residents at this time.
🚀 Opportunities to Grow
We work hard on a culture built on trust, accountability, and inclusion — one where you can take on more, make a lasting impact, and have some fun doing it.
🎩 Total Rewards
Remote-first since 2009
Flexible PTO and parental leave
100% premium coverage of medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
401(k) to invest in your future
$1,500 annual learning and development reimbursement
Travel to all-company meetings and team events
Generous home office allowance
TeamSnap swag when you start, plus a $50 store credit on every work anniversary
Monthly health and wellness reimbursement, and more
TeamSnap Total Rewards
🏆 Award-winning Culture
At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit - you're a culture add. Read our Culture Playbook to see how we play, what we ask of each other, and what drives us.
🧡 Inclusion and Diversity
Creativity and innovation don't come from cookie-cutter teams. We hold ourselves accountable for building a culture where everyone is valued.
Need any accommodations during the interview process? Just ask. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.
AI Notice
We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and resumes or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team; they don't replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people. Contact us if you'd like more information about how your data is processed.

At Zyte, we don't just collect web data—we solve complex web data challenges at scale. We are a globally distributed team that is bold, curious, and dedicated to building innovative ways to deliver clean, reliable web data from across the internet.
Data is our passion: We unlock access to open web data, empowering organizations—from startups to global enterprises—to power competitive intelligence, analytics, and AI pipelines
Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere in the world. With over 260 Zytans across 33 countries, our strength comes from diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills
Engineering excellence: We love diving deep into complex code bases, evaluating emerging technologies, and pushing technical boundaries. If you thrive on creative problem-solving and reliably delivering production-grade solutions, you will fit right in
Established system design framework: We systematically analyze functional and product requirements alongside architectural trade-offs to make informed, sustainable design decisions
Real-world distributed systems challenges: Tackle rare engineering problems in custom networking, high-throughput streaming, and large-scale orchestration under real-world operational constraints
Strong product ownership: Work on a profitable, market-leading platform with dedicated time and resources allocated for architectural research and strategic feature engineering
Why This Role?
Zyte API fetches the web through a ladder of routes: plain HTTP, headless browsers, and, for the hardest targets, Edge—our own residential network of real devices. Edge is the tier that must succeed when everything else has failed. Today, a Rust peer on residential Windows PCs long-polls a single command-and-control service (CNC) over mTLS gRPC; CNC schedules fetches onto peers, runs a CONNECT proxy gateway, owns geo-routing, per-site cooldowns, and bandwidth quotas. It must grow from thousands of nodes to tens of millions of requests a day with rock-solid reliability.
The Edge Platform squad owns the control plane and data plane of this residential stack across Windows, Android, and Linux. The next step is building a proper Fleet Manager: a control plane with provider adapters (volunteer PCs, mobile-IP device farms, self-hosted nodes), a reconciler, rollout control, and metrics export sitting beside CNC as the data plane. You will design and operate that system—handling the scheduling, networking, proxying, and reliability work that turns residential devices into infrastructure other squads depend on. You will work directly with the Team Lead, a Principal Engineer, and partner engineering squads across Zyte.
What You'll Do
Scale the data plane. Evolve CNC from a single-replica service into a horizontally scalable fetch scheduler: node selection that respects geo, site cooldowns, jail and per-peer quotas while avoiding detectable patterns, at 50-100M requests per day
Build the Fleet Manager control plane. Design and ship the inventory, health, configuration and software-rollout plane for the fleet: provider adapters, a reconciler, a rollout controller and an exporter to BigQuery, so a second device provider can be onboarded without bespoke scripts
Own the proxy path. Operate and improve the CONNECT proxy gateway and session handling on the edge, and work with the API squad on IP reputation, proxy leases and request scheduling so Edge slots cleanly into the platform's proxy plane
Engineer the networking. mTLS gRPC between control plane and peers, long-poll and streaming semantics over unreliable residential links, NAT and carrier-grade NAT behaviour, and bandwidth accounting that is correct under contention
Make it reliable. Define SLOs for availability, success and latency of the Edge route; build the metrics on peer count, drop-off and bandwidth that hold us and our supply partners accountable; run blue/green rollouts of CNC and peers safely
Share production ownership. Take part in the squad's on-call rotation, lead incident post-mortems and turn operational lessons into platform improvements
Raise the bar. Write RFDs for scheduling, fleet management and failover; review designs across the squad; and bring distributed-systems rigour (consistency, backpressure, idempotency, blast radius) to a young codebase
Requirements
Who You Are
5+ years of production Rust experience, shipping and operating services you own end to end
Distributed systems: you have designed and run schedulers, control planes or stateful services at scale, and can reason about consistency, partitions, backpressure and idempotency without a whiteboard
Deep networking: TCP, TLS and HTTP at the handshake and packet level, gRPC and long-lived connections across NAT and lossy links, and what a client looks like on the wire
Proxy expertise: you have built or operated forward proxies, proxy gateways or residential/ISP proxy infrastructure, and understand IP reputation, session stickiness and pool health
Ops and reliability experience: SLOs and error budgets, observability you built yourself, production incidents you led, and comfort with being on call
Cross-platform awareness: comfortable with Rust running on Windows, Linux and Android targets, and with FFI boundaries when the data plane needs them
Async communication: strong written communication for a globally distributed, remote-first environment
Curious problem solver: you like finding out why a system behaves the way it does under load, and fixing the cause rather than the symptom
Our Tech Stack
Languages: Rust (tokio, tonic), C++ (Cronet) at the peer boundary; Python and Java in the services we integrate with
Protocols: gRPC and protobuf over mTLS, HTTP CONNECT proxying, the Chromium network stack and our own browserless HTTP client
Infrastructure: GCP and Kubernetes for the control plane, Terraform, blue/green deployments; multi-cloud (OCI, GCP) and data centres (Hetzner, Servers.com) across the wider platform
Data & Messaging: Valkey, BigQuery, Confluent Kafka
Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry
Bonus Points
Mobile or desktop Rust: experience shipping Rust on Android, Windows or macOS, or binding Rust to C/C++ via FFI
Fleet or device management: reconcilers, rollout controllers, IoT or volunteer-computing fleets
Anti-bot and fingerprinting: understanding of how TLS, HTTP and IP signals are used to classify traffic
Web scraping & crawling experience: familiarity with the technical challenges of large-scale web data extraction
Open source contributions: history of contributing to Rust, networking or distributed-systems open-source projects
Why Join Us?
Impact at scale: Build the residential network tier behind web-scale data pipelines for top-tier global enterprises
Autonomy and flexibility: Enjoy a genuine remote-first culture with flexible working hours and high organizational trust
Continuous innovation: Solve emerging, complex technical challenges as AI and web data extraction rapidly evolve
Global community: Collaborate with a passionate, diverse team of distributed systems engineers and data specialists across the world
If you are a Rust engineer who wants to turn tens of thousands of residential devices into dependable infrastructure, we would love to hear from you. Join us in building the fleet behind web data extraction at Zyte.
Benefits
By joining the Zyte team, you will:
Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team
Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work
Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe
Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools

China produces about 85% of the world's cathode active material. The West needs new battery chemistries to compete, but traditional R&D can take years to deliver them. 
 
Today, we announced $45M in funding to change that. 
 
Backed by  Zone II Ventures, and Course Corrected, we're scaling our AI-powered Discovery Engine, which combines 18 years of proprietary battery data with automated labs that physically build and test new materials. Over these 18 years our platform has run more than 225 projects for more than 85 customers across the battery value chain, including nearly a dozen Fortune 500 companies, and has resulted in more than 100 battery patents.  Along the way, the platform generated an internally consistent dataset covering more than 500,000 physical cells tested at over 165 million cycles.  
 
Our technology has already helped deliver DRX, a new family of nickel- and cobalt-free cathode materials designed to reduce dependence on China. Now, we're bringing DRX toward commercialization while using AI to accelerate the next generation of breakthroughs. 
 
Led by founder and CEO Mathias Ingvarsson, COO and former Tesla manufacturing leader Steven Prast, and Chief Scientific Officer Dee Strand, we're building a faster path from battery discovery to commercial deployment. 
 
Read more in Fortune by Nick Lichtenberg. Article link in the first comment.
